newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares inch lower as election looms.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares inch lower as election looms.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 0.78 percent on Wednesday as investors kept to the sidelines ahead of the country's second general election on Sunday, and traders said further losses could be expected over the next few days.
"Foreign investors are not as active as they were, they are probably waiting for the elections and the listings of some newly privatised companies," said one trader.
* Turnover rose to 200.6 million tolars from 92.6 million.
* Overall 11 shares fell, four rose and one was unchanged, while another eight were untraded.
* Drug producer Lek was the most actively traded, falling 0.97 percent to 20,400 tolars on volume of 5,820 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
